ai.definition: AI21 Labs' AI Models are advanced natural language processing (NLP) systems designed to generate human-like text and code.
ai.howItWorks: These models leverage deep learning techniques, particularly transformer architectures, to process and generate natural language. They are trained on large datasets to understand the nuances of human communication and programming languages, allowing them to produce coherent and contextually relevant outputs.
ai.problemSolved: AI21 Labs' AI Models address the need for efficient text generation in various applications, from content creation and customer support to code development and documentation.
ai.manufacturing: The manufacturing process involves training large neural networks on extensive datasets. This requires significant computational resources and time.
ai.buildProcess: The build process includes data collection, model architecture design, training, fine-tuning, and validation. It is an iterative process that often involves multiple rounds of optimization to improve performance.
ai.costDrivers: Cost drivers include the need for powerful hardware (GPUs), large datasets, and skilled personnel. The cost also depends on the scale of training and the complexity of the model architecture.
ai.lifecycleOutlook: The outlook is positive as NLP technologies are increasingly adopted across various industries, but competition is expected to intensify with more players entering the market.
ai.regulation: Regulations vary by region and application. There may be concerns related to data privacy, content accuracy, and ethical use of AI models, which could lead to additional compliance requirements.
ai.risks: Risks include technical challenges such as overfitting, model bias, and interpretability issues. Additionally, there are risks associated with data security and potential misuse of the technology.
ai.profitability: Profitability is contingent on successful commercialization in targeted markets. Revenue models could include subscription services, API access fees, or licensing agreements.
ai.futureDevelopment: Future development may focus on improving model performance, reducing computational requirements, enhancing ethical considerations, and expanding application areas such as automated coding and content generation for diverse industries.

glossary.def: A type of neural network architecture that has been pivotal in the development of advanced NLP models, enabling them to process and generate human-like text.
A subset of machine learning that uses deep neural networks with multiple layers to model complex patterns in data.
A field of artificial intelligence focused on the interaction between computers and human (natural) languages, enabling machines to understand, interpret, and generate human-like text.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: collects and cleans the massive text and code corpora the model learns from.

subsystems.name: Tokenizer
subsystems.role: splits text into tokens the model can process.

subsystems.name: Model architecture
subsystems.role: the neural network that learns language patterns; AI21 Labs has used both pure Transformer and hybrid state-space/Transformer designs.
parts: state-space layers (in hybrid models like Jamba)

subsystems.name: Training infrastructure
subsystems.role: runs pre-training across thousands of accelerators for weeks or months.

subsystems.name: Fine-tuning and alignment
subsystems.role: adapts the base model to follow instructions and reduce harmful outputs.

subsystems.name: Inference serving
subsystems.role: delivers fast, cost-effective responses to users via API.

buildSteps.title: Collect data
buildSteps.detail: Gather text from web crawls, books, articles and code repositories, aiming for broad coverage of language and knowledge.

buildSteps.title: Clean and filter
buildSteps.detail: Remove duplicates, boilerplate, toxic content and personal data, and apply quality filters to keep useful text.

buildSteps.title: Train tokenizer
buildSteps.detail: Build a vocabulary from the cleaned corpus using byte-pair encoding so common words and subwords become single tokens.

buildSteps.title: Design architecture
buildSteps.detail: Choose layer count, attention pattern and, for hybrid models, how to mix Transformer and state-space layers for efficiency and long context.

buildSteps.title: Pre-train
buildSteps.detail: Train the model to predict the next token on the massive corpus, using distributed training across many accelerators for weeks or months.

buildSteps.title: Fine-tune and align
buildSteps.detail: Apply supervised instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback to make the model helpful and safe.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate
buildSteps.detail: Benchmark on language understanding, reasoning and code tasks, and run safety and bias tests before release.

buildSteps.title: Deploy and serve
buildSteps.detail: Serve the model through an API with optimised inference, monitoring, and regular updates as new versions are trained.
